description.en: A secretary panel that reads your unread GitHub notifications, works out per notification which ones are already resolved, and closes them for you; it also keeps the dated things you tell it — bills, renewals, document expiries, birthdays — and reminds you when they come due. The inbox is read-only and secrets stay in the system keychain. Requires a GitHub login for the notification half; manual entries work without it.
description.zh: 小秘书面板：读取未读 GitHub 通知，逐条判断哪些事情已经结束并替你关掉；也记住你交代的账单、续费、证件到期与生日，到点提醒。邮件只读，密钥只进系统钥匙串。通知部分需登录 GitHub，手动交代的事项不需要。
